verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own docs show a versioned endpoint path (POST /v3/models/videos), so API versioning exists in some form. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support guarantees. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
